claim: CPTPP entered into force between the United Kingdom and Malaysia on 15 December 2024.
Spain's Royal Decree 91/2025 on energy and climate governance was published on 22 February 2025 and entered into force the next day, on 23 February 2025.
Spain's Royal Decree 396/2025 on service passports was published on 21 May 2025 and entered into force that same day, on 21 May 2025.
